newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - March 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - March 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Slain Filipino designer to be buried in Khobar on Tuesday, official says.
- Kingdom's domestic demand for oil products grew 24 percent in the last two decades.
- Saudi Arabia to set up new road projects in Najran region at a cost of 6.6 billion riyals.
- King Fahd decrees sending aid to Iran and Pakistan to help victims of earthquakes.
